SELECT t1.id, t1.`name`, t1.version_id, t1.inbound_price, t1.one_price, t1.supplier_id FROM zc_product t1 LEFT JOIN zc_product_version t2 ON t1.version_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND t1.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.name}, '%')
AND t1.version_id = #{reqVO.versionId}
ORDER BY t1.id DESC
